description: This file defines the CallLog class and related functions for managing telephony call logs within the ERPNext system, including call validation, linking contacts and leads, call status handling, and real-time call popup notifications.

classes.name: CallLog
classes.description: Represents a telephony call log with methods for validation, linking contacts/leads, handling call status updates, and triggering call popups.

methods.name: add_call_summary
methods.description: Adds a summary comment to a call log document.

methods.name: get_employees_with_number
methods.description: Retrieves employee emails associated with a phone number, using cache for optimization.

methods.name: link_existing_conversations
methods.description: Links existing call logs to a contact or lead based on phone numbers.

methods.name: get_linked_call_logs
methods.description: Fetches call logs linked to a specific doctype and document name for timeline display.
